rules.description: Left GUI (thumb cluster Super) held alone → Mission Control; tap or hold+key → Cmd
Right GUI held alone → Mission Control; tap or hold+key → Cmd
Home-row mods (Moonlander layer 0): hold a/;=Cmd, s/l=Shift, d/k=Alt, f/j=Ctrl. Spotlight = hold a + Space.
Left Command alone → Mission Control; with other keys it does nothing
Right Command alone → Mission Control; with other keys it does nothing
Space does nothing while Right Command is pending
Emacs C-x prefix: activate C-x mode (not in Emacs/terminals)
Emacs C-x subcommands: h=select-all C-f=open C-s=save k=close C-c=quit u=undo C-g=cancel
Emacs keybindings (not in Emacs/terminals): navigation, editing, clipboard, search
Emacs M-w copy → Cmd-c (not in Emacs, terminals, or browsers)
Right click pastes from clipboard in Ghostty
Home-row mods except Moonlander: hold a/;=Cmd, s/l=Shift, d/k=Alt, f/j=Ctrl. Spotlight = hold a + Space.
